approved: Taxation (Multinational—Global and Domestic Minimum Tax) Imposition Bill 2024
Written by a model from the explanatory memorandum; not the record
This bill is part of a package that would impose a 15% global minimum tax and an Australian domestic minimum tax on multinationals.
The package would apply the tax to fiscal years starting on or after 1 January 2024, with the Undertaxed Profits Rule applying from 1 January 2025.
The bill would commence the day after Royal Assent, but only if the Assessment Bill also commences.
Imposes a 15% global minimum tax and Australian domestic minimum tax on multinationals.
Applies the tax to fiscal years starting on or after 1 January 2024, with the Undertaxed Profits Rule applying from 1 January 2025.
Commences the day after Royal Assent, contingent on the Assessment Bill commencing.
Multinational enterprises subject to the global and domestic minimum tax rules.
Taxation (Multinational—Global and Domestic Minimum Tax) Imposition Act 2024
